problems.title: Server Maintenance Reward
problems.story: Server Maintenance Reward is an independent Quadrantcode practice scenario. A planning team has reduced its observations to an integer sequence and needs a precise maximum nonadjacent total result before the next decision can be made.
problems.statement: Implement the required function for Server Maintenance Reward. Interpret the supplied sequence exactly as described in the input contract, compute the maximum nonadjacent total, and return only the requested integer. The function must handle boundary cases and the largest stated input without modifying any external state.
problems.inputFormat: values contains nonnegative rewards in their fixed left-to-right order.
problems.outputFormat: Return the maximum total reward obtainable without selecting adjacent positions.

parameters.name: values
parameters.description: The complete integer encoding described by this problem.

constraints: The result fits in signed 64-bit range.

examples.explanation: Example 1 follows the stated maximum nonadjacent total process. Every contributing value is visible in the input, and the computed result is 12.
Example 2 follows the stated maximum nonadjacent total process. Every contributing value is visible in the input, and the computed result is 4.

testCases.explanation: Applying the maximum nonadjacent total rule to this input produces the stated result without using any unstated data.
Applying the maximum nonadjacent total rule to this input produces the stated result without using any unstated data.

hints: At each position, compare skipping it with taking it after the best result two positions back.
Only the previous two dynamic-programming states are needed.

editorial.overview: Use the recurrence best[i] = max(best[i-1], best[i-2] + values[i]) with two rolling variables.
editorial.bruteForceApproach: Recursively choose or skip every position, rejecting branches that choose adjacent positions.
editorial.optimalApproach: Maintain the best total through the previous position and through the position before it, updating once per reward.
editorial.correctnessProof: Every valid optimal selection either omits the current position, giving the previous best, or includes it, forcing omission of the previous position and giving the two-back best plus current reward. Taking the maximum covers both exhaustive cases.

c11.referenceSolution: long long solve(const long long*v,int n){long long a=0,b=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){long long z=b>a+v[i]?b:a+v[i];a=b;b=z;}return b;}

cpp17.referenceSolution: long long solve(const vector<long long>&v){long long a=0,b=0;for(auto x:v){auto n=max(b,a+x);a=b;b=n;}return b;}

java.referenceSolution: static long solve(long[]v){long a=0,b=0;for(long x:v){long n=Math.max(b,a+x);a=b;b=n;}return b;}

javascript.referenceSolution: function solve(v){let a=0,b=0;for(const x of v){const n=Math.max(b,a+x);a=b;b=n;}return b;}
